name: Forno Acqua Premium B White Luxurious Smart Toilet
shortDescription: FORNO ACQUA Smart Toilet – Sleek Comfort Meets Intelligent Design. Upgrade your bathroom with the FORNO ACQUA Smart Toilet, a modern tankless skirted toilet that blends elegant design with advanced features for everyday luxury. Perfect for homeowners seeking smart functionality without a built-in bidet—ideal for powder rooms and secondary bathrooms. Auto-sensing lid, seat, and flush plus Foot sensor for total touchless operation. Certified to MaP’s highest performance standards, the Auto Dual Flush system delivers powerful, clog-free performance. Built-in heated seat for year-round cozy comfort. Integrated deodorizer for a fresher bathroom environment. Sleek tankless, skirted design for easy cleaning and a minimalist look. Whether you're remodeling or building new, the FORNO ACQUA Smart Toilet delivers a cleaner, more comfortable lifestyle without the complexity of a bidet. Experience intelligent comfort with FORNO ACQUA.

features.text: Premium B Smart Toilet Heated Seat
Heated Seat – Enjoy soothing warmth with 4 adjustable temperature settings for personalized comfort year-round
High-Performance Flush – AcquaPOWER technology delivers best-in-class 1000g MaP performance for a quiet, powerful, clog-free waste removal
Touchless Walk-Away Flush – AcquaSMART triggers a smart dual flush when you step away or tap the foot sensor. Hands-free, hygienic, and effortless
AcquaSMART Advanced Technology - automatic lid open & close, foot sensor seat open & close and lid close for seamless, hands-free convenience
Smart Dual Flush – Automatically adjusts flush volume based on usage to maximize water efficiency
Foot Sensor – Flush or lift the lid & seat with a tap of your foot. Hands-free, hygienic control for a cleaner bathroom experience
